title: Practice 7: Kinds of imperative: давай, пусть

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Hold on to the strap. The train will start to move soon.
exercises.why: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

«Пусть он (она) делает, сделает это» — let him do it. «Давайте + infinitive of the imperfective … давайте + perfective future» — let's. — DLI, Lesson 84. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
